capabilities: fetch LEGO set data by set number from the Brickset API
create formatted markdown notes with set details
download and embed set images in notes
sync LEGO collection fields between notes and Brickset
extras: README includes a privacy/security section explaining network behavior and notes that credentials are stored in plaintext; also carries a trademark disclaimer that it is unaffiliated with LEGO Group or Brickset.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull LEGO set information and images into notes, so collectors must copy details manually.

relations.evidence: integrates with the Brickset API to fetch LEGO set information

summary: Fetches LEGO set details from the Brickset API and creates formatted notes with set data, images, and frontmatter tags.
